title: [GMCP 203.012.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Subscriptions, notifications, progress, and operational messages
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-012-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Modern subscriptions/listen filters and acknowledgement metadata work for tools, prompts, resources and resource updates, with bounded fan-out, ordering guarantees, cancellation, reconnect policy, backpressure and authorization re-checks. Progress and operational log notifications correlate to the originating request, obey requested levels and redaction, and never become an unbounded covert channel. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
